title: The Paper Bridge
author: Sable Reyes
blurb: Kestrel Ishikawa, a mapmaker's apprentice finishing the atlas the master died for, keeps a low profile and busy hands. Then a child is left at the door with instructions to forget the face — and she is pulled straight into the middle of it. To get through this, she must smuggle the evidence past three checkpoints before the armistice is signed — or isn't.
style: atmospheric and lyrical, with strong sensory detail
